entries.zh: 陪巡：陪同巡视、探访；随受访者同行
entries.en: to accompany the visited party on a visit (inspection)
to accompany without parting, to stay close by
to follow, to go along with
to bring along, to take with one
to follow as a retainer; to attend as a follower

entries.zh: 随从主人；如仆役般随侍
entries.en: to attend on one's lord as a servant
to escort, to guard while accompanying
to see off, to escort a departing person
to assist, to support from the side
to assist in government
to aid and counsel a ruler
to see off, to escort
entries.notes: 与第 8 条同字「送」，但此条 M/R 均作 zòng，或为异读另立一条。

entries.en: to see a guest out, as far as the door
to accompany the dead to burial, to attend a funeral
to travel together, to accompany on a journey
entries.notes: 「行程」为名词，与西语动词 acompañar 词性不合，暂按同行上路解。

entries.en: to lead along, to bring (someone) along
entries.notes: H 栏字形在焦/炰/𤆬之间存疑，音 choǎᶜ 与闽南语「带领、引带」义相合。

entries.en: to escort the bride, to accompany the newly wed
entries.notes: 首字与第 16 条同为存疑字，据「acompañar los desposados」与「嫁」定为送嫁义。

entries.en: sedan-chair attendant, the footman who follows the chair

entries.zh: 作伴；陪伴（原字作「絆」，当为「伴」之借字或形讹）
entries.en: to keep company, to accompany (the written character 絆 here stands for 伴)
entries.notes: 「絆」本义为绊系，与 acompañar 不合；M/R 平声读音亦近「伴」。

entries.en: to advise, to counsel
entries.notes: 原字「徇」与 aconsejar 义不合，疑为「諄」「詢」一类借字或形讹，据音 zûn 与西语义定。

entries.en: to enlighten, to remind and set right

entries.zh: 〔语义存疑〕指点检点；指出疏失加以规正
entries.en: to point out faults, to check and correct (sense uncertain)
entries.notes: L 栏词头残缺，H「失點檢」三字与 aconsejar 的对应关系无法定夺。
